newsitem.title: CHINA: China Xi'an plane company's output value up 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Xi'an plane company's output value up 40 pct.

text.p: The value of output at China's Xi'an Aircraft Co (XAC) soared to 960 million yuan ($115 million) in the first eight months, up 40 percent from the same period of 1995, company officials and state media said on Wednesday.
The value of the aircraft maker's output was 1.066 billion yuan in 1995, three times the total for 1990, an XAC official told Reuters by telephone.
The Xinhua Daily Telegraph attributed the growth in production value to the firm's technological reform and its development of civilian products to augment production of military aircraft and parts.
XAC, based in Xi'an, capital of China's northern Shaanxi province, had invested 570 million yuan in the introduction of new equipment, the official said but gave no details.
